purpose: The single source of truth for behavioural clause failures the owner has accepted as open in docs/runtime-wall-trace.json. Read by scripts/build.mjs (the release gate) and by tests/runtime-evidence-binding.test.mjs (the tripwire), so the build and the tripwire cannot disagree about what is recorded.
owner_decision: 2026-09-21 — release gate semantics. The default build passes when there is no UNRECORDED gate failure and gate.timing_and_dli_passed is true. A new failure, or a recorded failure that silently disappears, fails the build exactly as it fails the tripwire. gate.passed keeps its meaning: false while any failure is recorded.

classes.a-stale-scenario: (a) The scenario cannot contain the behaviour; the assertion is right. Fixed by extending the scenario, never by loosening the assertion — recorded when extending is not cheap.
classes.b-wrong-selection: (b) The clause reads the wrong coverage; fixed by correcting the selection and proving the corrected clause still fails when the behaviour is missing.
classes.c-real-failure: (c) A real failure of the build. Neither fixed nor weakened here; recorded so the evidence stays a truthful description of the build.
classes.pre-existing-unclassified: Pre-existing failure carried unchanged; no session has classified it into (a), (b) or (c) yet.

failures.message: capital-contact-allied-medium did not capture 16 consecutive contact rasters
failures.note: MEASURED 2026-10-01 at 1,600 frames: the capital sector opens at frame 774 and a shell hits at 895, but the mode-1 contact geometry (bolt top = player top + 4) is never captured, and the passive player has already lost two lives in the fighter phase (health 0 at 146 and 458), so the later 'two HULL units, lives 3' clause could not hold either. A longer budget does not repair it. Owner decision 2026-10-01 (trace-clause-repairs, Q3): stays recorded, reclassified from pre-existing-unclassified to (a); the redesign of the contact scenarios is chore/contact-scenario-redesign.

failures.message: capital-contact-hostile-medium did not capture 16 consecutive contact rasters
failures.note: MEASURED 2026-10-01 at 1,600 frames: the capital sector never opens (sector_state 7 on every frame) with the passive player held at x 84, worn down 9 -> 1. A probe-only preamble (sweep + fire, health and lives held while OPEN) opens the sector at 667, but a damage call that applies no damage (769, 10 -> 10) precedes the first hit and no contact raster is captured. Owner decision 2026-10-01 (trace-clause-repairs, Q3): stays recorded, reclassified from pre-existing-unclassified to (a); the redesign of the contact scenarios is chore/contact-scenario-redesign.

failures.message: lower-playfield-hostile-contact-atr-hard did not capture 16 consecutive contact rasters
failures.note: MEASURED 2026-10-01: on HARD the hostile shells of level 1 stop at Y 180, under the policy's shell_y >= 191; on MEDIUM (probe) they follow the player and stop at Y 156, so a difficulty change does not repair it. RENAMED 2026-09-30 with its session (owner decision 1, docs/plans/atr-only-build.md §5): the XEX-only session switched to the ATR as -atr-hard. Owner decision 2026-10-01 (trace-clause-repairs, Q3): stays recorded, reclassified from pre-existing-unclassified to (a); the redesign of the contact scenarios is chore/contact-scenario-redesign.

removed_2026_10_01.note: Left the recorded set in trace-clause-repairs (docs/plans/trace-clause-repairs.md). Each was an observer error, class (b); the clause's assertion is unchanged and passes on the regenerated evidence.

entries.message: engine-atr-a5-0-immediate first DLI did not select byte three of the active A2 list
entries.fix: The observer counted the first-DLI selection only inside the measured main-loop window; it now also records it in the wait after the end hook (additive header fields engine_playfield_select_idle_*). 150 of 150 frames select byte three.

entries.message: Booster release did not clear the capsule from its PMG plane in the release frame
entries.fix: The observer counted entries to clear_fighter_pickup_pmg; the publication's re-entry on an empty plane erases nothing. It now counts the entries that zero the plane (additive header field pickup_erase_writes): 1 on each of the four release frames, plane empty.
